mapper.select: SELECT bc.comment_id, bc.board_id, CASE WHEN bc.parent_comment_id = 0 THEN NULL ELSE bc.parent_comment_id END AS parent_comment_id, bc.emp_id, e.empno, e.ename, e.dept, bc.content, TO_CHAR(bc.created_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created_date, TO_CHAR(bc.updated_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updated_date, bc.status, bc.use_yn, bc.remark, LEVEL - 1 AS comment_level, (LEVEL - 1) * 42 AS comment_indent FROM board_comment bc, emp e WHERE bc.emp_id = e.emp_id AND bc.board_id = #{board_id} AND bc.use_yn = 'Y' START WITH bc.board_id = #{board_id} AND bc.use_yn = 'Y' AND (bc.parent_comment_id IS NULL OR bc.parent_comment_id = 0) CONNECT BY PRIOR bc.comment_id = bc.parent_comment_id AND bc.board_id = #{board_id} AND bc.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER SIBLINGS BY bc.comment_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_comment ( comment_id, board_id, parent_comment_id, emp_id, content, created_date, updated_date, status, use_yn, remark ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(comment_id), 0) + 1 FROM board_comment), #{board_id}, #{parent_comment_id, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, (SELECT emp_id FROM emp WHERE empno = #{empno}), #{content}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, '등록', 'Y', NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE board_comment SET content = #{content}, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE comment_id = #{comment_id} AND use_yn = 'Y' AND ( #{role} = 'ADMIN' OR emp_id = ( SELECT emp_id FROM emp WHERE empno = #{empno} ) )

UPDATE board_comment SET use_yn = 'N', status = '삭제', updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE comment_id IN ( SELECT comment_id FROM board_comment START WITH comment_id = #{comment_id} CONNECT BY PRIOR comment_id = parent_comment_id ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM board_comment target_comment WHERE target_comment.comment_id = #{comment_id} AND ( #{role} = 'ADMIN' OR target_comment.emp_id = ( SELECT emp_id FROM emp WHERE empno = #{empno} ) ) )
mapper.select: SELECT bc.comment_id, bc.board_id, CASE WHEN bc.parent_comment_id = 0 THEN NULL ELSE bc.parent_comment_id END AS parent_comment_id, bc.emp_id, e.empno, e.ename, e.dept, bc.content, TO_CHAR(bc.created_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created_date, TO_CHAR(bc.updated_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updated_date, bc.status, bc.use_yn, bc.remark, 0 AS comment_level, 0 AS comment_indent FROM board_comment bc, emp e WHERE bc.emp_id = e.emp_id AND bc.comment_id = #{comment_id} AND bc.use_yn = 'Y'
